root_cause: Direct file execution placed the scripts directory rather than the repository root on sys.path, so the package-qualified sibling import failed before argument parsing.
fix_scope: When and only when the matrix file is executed as a script, prepend its repository root to sys.path before importing the sibling driver. Module-import behavior is unchanged.
run_id_reuse: No run ID was materialized or attempted, so the frozen pilot IDs remain unused.
